title: Ad hoc filters are now applied twice (three times under shard splitting), duplicating label filters
description: applyTemplateVariables is not idempotent when request.filters is non-empty; it is called multiple times through the call chain (runSplitQuery → runSplitGroupedQueries → datasource.runQuery → DataSourceWithBackend.query), causing duplicate label filters in the final Loki query. With shardQuerySplitting enabled, this occurs three times. Fix: interpolate for split decisions without re-interpolating in downstream layers, either by keeping request.targets raw or by passing a skipTemplateVariables marker.
